I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

That number comes from #north-random, where Ilse posted on Oct 13 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub. Dana is in that channel, so she could already see it. Ilse's message also said not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets, so I passed that on too.

Dana had sent me her own guess at the ticket number in a private message and asked me to keep it to myself, so I left it out of the channel reply.
